title: Schedule of Points Relief on Deposit Pre-Order Cancellation Charges — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders
content:
Marlowe Rewards points reduce the charge kept when a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order is cancelled at will. The relief rests on the Marlowe Rewards points counted over the last 12 months. They are counted in the way that depends on the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier. Those points multiply the cancellation charge as follows.

| Points counted, last 12 months | Cancellation charge multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 5000 or more | 0.8 |
| 2000 up to fewer than 5000 | 0.9 |
| Fewer than 2000 | 1.0 |

The multiplier applies to the cancellation charge as one more factor of the same product of the reserved price and the charge rate. It applies before the cap at the deposit held and before the rounding to the cent, both of which apply to the whole product.

**Band edges**

| Points | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 1999 | 1.0 |
| 2000 | 0.9 |
| 4999 | 0.9 |
| 5000 | 0.8 |

**Example (hypothetical).** A charge of $50.00 for a customer with 2600 points counted becomes $45.00. With 5200 points counted it would become $40.00.
